_about: Public-domain Alexander Keith (1792-1880), Church of Scotland and Free Church minister and writer on prophecy, for the Word Hoard: Evidence of the Truth of the Christian Religion from the Fulfilment of Prophecy, The Signs of the Times (2 vols.), Demonstration of the Truth of the Christian Religion, The Land of Israel, Isaiah as it is, and The Harmony of Prophecy. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 84 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

keith-evidence-1828: Evidence of the truth of the Christian religion, derived from the literal fulfilment of prophecy; particularly as illustrated by the history of the Jews, and by the discoveries of recent travellers (Edinburgh : Waugh & Innes, 1828)

keith-evidence-1833: The evidence of prophecy (New York, American tract society, 1833)
keith-demonstration: Demonstration of the truth of the Christian religion ([n. p.], 1844)
keith-land-of-israel: Land of Israel : according to the covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and Jacob (Edinburgh : William Whyte, 1844)
